BEFORE YOU START

Any questions?

The essentials to help you choose.

Are the plugins really free?+

Yes. All 4 plugins in this collection are free and available on Modrinth. Each plugin’s price is always shown on its card.

Which Minecraft versions are supported?+

Open “View details” on any plugin to see its compatibility. Before downloading, check the exact Minecraft version and platform on its Modrinth versions page.

Can I use these on a server network?+

LexBounty, LexGauntlet and LexTPA support server networks. Dependencies vary: check each plugin’s details and documentation to configure MySQL or Redis when needed.

Where can I get help or report a problem?+

Join the Discord community. Include the plugin, your server version and the steps to reproduce the issue.
